options.A: Configure custom route export on VPC-2's side of the VPC-1 peering and import on VPC-1's side, expecting VPC-3's routes to propagate through the chain; a peering session does not re-export peer-learned routes, so VPC-1 still cannot reach VPC-3.
options.B: Enable IP forwarding (can-ip-forward) on VPC-2's instances, assuming disabled forwarding blocks VPC-1 from reaching VPC-3; peering routes do not traverse a hop network at the routing layer, so forwarding settings on VPC-2's instances have no effect on VPC-1-to-VPC-3 reachability.
options.C: VPC-1 (10.128.0.0/20) and VPC-3 (10.132.0.0/20) are assumed to overlap, so peering drops the conflicting routes even after granting compute.networks.peerings.update; re-numbering the CIDR would fix a real overlap, but these ranges do not overlap, so workloads cannot communicate.

distractors.A: El export/import de rutas personalizadas no reexporta rutas aprendidas de otro emparejamiento; VPC-1 seguiria sin ver las rutas de VPC-3 aunque se habilite esta opcion.
distractors.B: El reenvio de IP (can-ip-forward) controla el reenvio de paquetes en instancias, no la propagacion de rutas de peering; no resuelve la falta de transito entre VPC-1 y VPC-3.
distractors.C: No hay solapamiento real de CIDR entre VPC-1 y VPC-3 en este escenario; el verdadero motivo es que el peering de VPC no es transitivo, no un conflicto de rangos.

options.A: Create a dedicated deployment service account, generate a private key via gcloud iam service-accounts keys create, store the JSON file in a GitHub Actions repository secret, and rotate it on a schedule that mints a new credential and deletes the old one.
options.B: Configure Workload Identity Federation with an OIDC Pool and Provider for token.actions.githubusercontent.com, then grant roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser on the deployment service account to a pool-wide principalSet covering every repository in the organization's pipeline.

distractors.A: Sigue generando y almacenando una clave JSON de larga duracion, justo lo que la politica de seguridad prohibe expresamente.
distractors.B: El principalSet de todo el pool sin condicion de atributo permite que cualquier repositorio del proveedor OIDC suplante la cuenta de servicio, una superficie de ataque demasiado amplia.

options.B: Enable Data Access audit logs on the relevant services, route them to a BigQuery sink, and run scheduled queries over 90 days of methodName values to derive a minimal permission set for each of the 500 service accounts.

distractors.B: Los Data Access audit logs generan un volumen enorme y solo registran que se llamo, no un analisis de que permisos son innecesarios; construir el modelo de permisos minimo a mano es manual, lento y propenso a errores frente a una herramienta de recomendacion automatizada.

options.B: Configure the constraints/storage.publicAccessPrevention and constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains organization policies on Project A and grant BigQuery and Cloud Storage roles solely to cleared program members through IAM conditions.
options.D: Configure Customer-Managed Encryption Keys backed by Cloud HSM for the BigQuery datasets and Cloud Storage buckets in Project A, and restrict the Cloud KMS CryptoKey Decrypter role to the program's service accounts in a separate key project.

distractors.B: Las politicas de organizacion y las condiciones IAM no bloquean la exfiltracion a nivel de API hacia buckets o datasets externos; solo limitan las asignaciones de roles, VPC-SC es lo que impone el perimetro criptografico exigido.
distractors.D: El cifrado con CMEK protege los datos en reposo pero no impide que un principal autorizado copie o exporte los datos hacia un proyecto externo; no bloquea la exfiltracion a traves de la API.

options.A: Run a Cloud Build pipeline with 'kubectl set image' and 'kubectl rollout status', gates at the 10%, 50% and 100% canary stages, and an operator running 'kubectl rollout undo' when the 5xx error rate exceeds threshold, instead of native automatic rollback.
options.C: Use Config Sync to reconcile rendered manifests from a Git repository into the GKE fleet, changing the image tag through a pull request and rolling back the canary release within about 15 minutes when Cloud Monitoring reports a 5xx error rate above 1%.

distractors.A: Sustituye la progresion canary nativa por aprobaciones manuales y un operador humano ejecutando rollout undo; no cumple con el rollback automatico en segundos que exige el escenario.
distractors.C: Config Sync gestiona el estado deseado via GitOps pero no implementa una progresion canary por etapas de trafico ni una verificacion automatica de metricas; el rollback depende de revertir un commit, no de un umbral de error en tiempo real.

options.B: Configure a Cloud Billing Budget with a high threshold rule and enable the budget's built-in disable-billing-to-stop-usage automatic action so Cloud Billing itself unlinks the billing account from the sandbox project once the spending alert fires.
options.D: Configure per-project quota overrides via the Service Usage API (serviceusage.googleapis.com) capping Compute Engine CPUs, disk and egress bandwidth per sandbox project, so it cannot exceed its allotted monthly resource budget regardless of active VM termination needs.

distractors.B: La accion automatica integrada de Cloud Billing Budgets para deshabilitar la facturacion tiene un retraso de facturacion de hasta varias horas y no esta pensada como interruptor de emergencia instantaneo; no cumple el corte inmediato exigido.
distractors.D: Las cuotas de la Service Usage API limitan el consumo de recursos pero no desvinculan la cuenta de facturacion ni detienen el gasto ya comprometido; no es un verdadero interruptor de apagado de facturacion.

options.A: Cloud Spanner instances are provisioned only in whole nodes, so the team should share a single one-node instance (100 GB storage ceiling) between development and staging and separate the environments by database name.
options.D: Use a small Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance (db-custom-1-3840, 100GB disk) for dev and staging, then switch to Spanner in production, assuming both speak PostgreSQL over the same wire-protocol interface.

distractors.A: Cloud Spanner si admite unidades de procesamiento (PUs) fraccionarias desde hace tiempo; la premisa de que solo se aprovisiona en nodos completos es falsa.
distractors.D: Cloud SQL para PostgreSQL no es compatible en el cable con la interfaz de Cloud Spanner; cambiar la cadena de conexion en produccion rompe la aplicacion, no es una migracion transparente.

options.A: Enable Public Access Prevention on the bucket fleet to block public grants, and turn on Object Versioning (30 days of noncurrent generations) so objects an operator accidentally deletes from customer data can be restored with gcloud storage cp.
options.D: Enable Uniform Bucket-Level Access to remove legacy object ACLs, and attach an Autoclass configuration plus a 90-day Object Lifecycle Management rule so customer data an operator accidentally deletes from a corporate bucket stays recoverable for ninety days afterward.

distractors.A: Object Versioning protege sobrescrituras y borrados, pero no es Soft Delete y no ofrece una ventana de recuperacion configurable de 7 a 90 dias como exige la politica; ademas no unifica el control de acceso via IAM como UBLA.
distractors.D: Autoclass gestiona clases de almacenamiento por coste, no control de acceso; no elimina las ACL heredadas ni unifica los permisos bajo IAM como exige la primera mitad del requisito.

options.C: Set version_destroy_ttl to 30 days and an expire_time on each secret version, so stale credentials are destroyed on schedule and applications are forced to request a freshly created version from Secret Manager the next time they authenticate to the Cloud SQL database.
options.D: Schedule a Cloud Scheduler job on a 30-day cadence to invoke a Cloud Run job that generates a password, runs an ALTER USER statement on Cloud SQL, and overwrites the enabled secret version's payload via secretmanager.versions.access or secretmanager.versions.add, so consumers pinned to 'latest' need no code change.

distractors.C: version_destroy_ttl solo retrasa la destruccion de versiones; no genera automaticamente una contrasena nueva, no actualiza el usuario de Cloud SQL ni prueba la conexion, asi que no implementa el flujo de rotacion completo.
distractors.D: Sobrescribir en el sitio la version habilitada del secreto rompe el versionado y el historial de auditoria de Secret Manager, y un job de Cloud Scheduler no verifica la conexion antes de publicar el cambio.

options.A: Deploy OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation into the Java microservice and export distributed traces to Cloud Trace, using the span waterfall and per-request latency distributions to locate which code path drives the elevated CPU consumption in production.
options.C: Configure a CronJob that execs into the running GKE pods to capture jcmd thread dumps and Java Flight Recorder recordings, then merge the offline samples to find which methods dominate CPU time inside the production Java microservice.

distractors.A: Cloud Trace mide la latencia de las llamadas, no perfila el uso de CPU ni memoria a nivel de metodo; no localiza expresiones regulares ineficientes ni serializacion de objetos como pide el escenario.
distractors.C: Los volcados de hilo y Flight Recorder manuales requieren modificar el ciclo de vida del pod y no se ejecutan de forma continua con menos del 5% de sobrecarga; no cumple el requisito de perfilado continuo sin reiniciar.

options.B: Configure the Managed Instance Group's minimum instance count to match the observed peak size on the CPU-based autoscaler, leaving the existing target utilization policy reacting to whatever additional traffic surges above that permanently provisioned floor each morning.
options.C: Create a scaling schedule on the Managed Instance Group autoscaler starting at 08:00 with a 30-minute duration and a minimum required instance count equal to the peak size, leaving the reactive CPU utilization autoscaler active around that recurring morning traffic window.

distractors.B: Elevar el minimo permanente de instancias paga por capacidad ociosa fuera de la ventana punta y sigue siendo reactivo ante cualquier trafico por encima de ese piso; no es autoescalado predictivo basado en patrones historicos.
distractors.C: Una ventana de escalado fija a las 08:00 no se adapta si el pico llega antes o despues, ni aprende de la variacion dia a dia; sigue sin anticipar la demanda mediante aprendizaje automatico.

options.A: Store the firmware images and certificates in a multi-region 'us' Cloud Storage bucket spanning 2 regions, relying on Google's built-in geo-redundancy to survive the loss of a single region.
options.B: Create a single-region Cloud Storage bucket for the firmware images in us-central1, and run an hourly Storage Transfer Service job copying changed certificates into a second bucket in us-east1 with checksum verification.
options.C: Create a Dual-Region Cloud Storage bucket spanning us-central1 and us-east1 for disaster recovery, relying on default asynchronous replication (roughly 60 min) and monitoring metrics to confirm both regions hold every object.

distractors.A: Un bucket multi-region no ofrece un SLA de replicacion garantizado; el RPO de menos de 15 minutos no esta contractualmente asegurado con la redundancia geografica estandar.
distractors.B: Una copia por lotes cada hora deja una ventana de perdida de datos de hasta 60 minutos, incumpliendo el RPO de menos de 15 minutos exigido.
distractors.C: La replicacion asincrona por defecto de un bucket Dual-Region no tiene SLA de tiempo; sin Turbo Replication no se garantiza el RPO de 15 minutos, solo se estima.

options.A: Create a second Cloud DNS private zone for 'corp.internal' in Project B authorized for VPC-B and keep its record set synchronized with the zone in Project A through a Cloud Build job triggered whenever a change is merged.
options.C: Publish 'corp.internal' as a Cloud DNS public managed-zone containing the RFC-1918 addresses of the microservices, restricting who can reach them with VPC firewall-rules rather than with the visibility of the dns.records themselves.

distractors.A: Sincronizar manualmente una segunda zona privada via un job de Cloud Build introduce retraso y riesgo de desincronizacion; no es la solucion nativa de Cloud DNS Peering pensada para este caso.
distractors.C: Publicar una zona publica expone las direcciones RFC 1918 de los microservicios a cualquiera con acceso a DNS publico, violando el requisito de no exponer la zona publicamente.

options.B: Deploy an Internal Passthrough Network Load Balancer in each region, publish both forwarding-rule addresses to clients, and let each client retry the other address on failure via app-level fallback.
options.C: Publish the internal microservice through an External Load Balancer with a public Anycast IP, restricting access with VPC firewall-rules and Cloud Armor security-policies allowing only corporate ranges.

distractors.B: Publicar dos direcciones de forwarding rule y delegar el failover al reintento del cliente no ofrece una unica IP interna global ni failover transparente en el balanceador.
distractors.C: Un balanceador externo con IP Anycast publica expone el servicio interno a Internet, incumpliendo el requisito de acceso privado con una sola IP interna.

options.A: Attach Cloud Armor security policies (OWASP ModSecurity rule set) to the external Application Load Balancer, inspecting each request for exploit and malware before it reaches the VMs, without vulnerability agents or a bottleneck appliance.
options.B: Enable VPC Flow Logs at 100 percent sampling network-wide and stream them into Security Command Center Event Threat Detection, correlating the 5-tuple connection records to identify malware, spyware and exploit attempts.

distractors.A: Cloud Armor con el conjunto de reglas OWASP inspecciona solo el trafico HTTP(S) que llega al Application Load Balancer; no cubre el trafico East-West entre subredes ni protocolos no HTTP como exige un IDS de red completo.
distractors.B: Los Flow Logs con Event Threat Detection correlacionan metadatos de conexion (5-tuple), no inspeccionan la carga util del paquete; no detectan firmas de malware o exploits dentro del payload como un IDS real.

options.C: Configure the org policy constraint 'constraints/storage.publicAccessPrevention' org-wide so allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers can't get storage.objectViewer, and audit monthly via Cloud Asset Inventory instead of remediating the SCC finding or removing the binding automatically.
options.D: Schedule an hourly Cloud Run job that enumerates each bucket with 'gcloud storage buckets get-iam-policy', removes the allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers bindings it finds instead of reacting to a Security Command Center finding automatically, writes the change to Cloud Logging and posts the result to the SOC Slack channel.

distractors.C: Enforzar la restriccion de acceso publico previene nuevas exposiciones pero no remedia automaticamente el hallazgo activo de Security Command Center ni retira el binding publico ya concedido en menos de 30 segundos.
distractors.D: Un job por lotes cada hora no cumple la ventana de remediacion de 30 segundos exigida; deja el bucket publico expuesto durante minutos u horas entre ejecuciones.

options.B: Have the Checkout Service return HTTP 200 to the customer first and then call the Notification Service from a background thread after the response has been written, leaving the Inventory-Payment-Shipping call chain still synchronous and still able to block and fail the order if one of those services is slow.

distractors.B: Responder 200 antes de notificar solo mueve el trabajo a un hilo en segundo plano dentro del mismo proceso; si el servicio de notificacion esta caido, el hilo o su pool se agotan igualmente y el acoplamiento sincrono entre servicios permanece intacto.

options.A: Leave concurrency at 1 but enable CPU-always-allocated with startup-CPU-boost and set minimum instances to 20, so the Node.js event loop is never throttled and warm container instances absorb the asynchronous Cloud SQL traffic without cold starts.
options.C: Set concurrency to the maximum value of 1000 while keeping the default 1-vCPU / 512-MiB container profile, so a very small number of container instances absorbs the whole asynchronous Cloud SQL request volume and billing drops accordingly.

distractors.A: CPU always allocated y minimo de instancias con concurrencia en 1 elimina los cold starts pero mantiene un contenedor por solicitud, multiplicando el numero de instancias y el coste en vez de reducirlo.
distractors.C: Concurrencia 1000 con el perfil de CPU/memoria por defecto satura la CPU y la memoria del contenedor bajo carga real, degradando la latencia en vez de optimizar coste y throughput.

options.C: Deploy a Standard GKE cluster with public node IP addresses protected by Cloud Armor and firewall rules, enable Workload Identity for pod authentication and turn on Shielded GKE Nodes with Secure Boot and integrity monitoring across the cluster's node pools.

distractors.C: Los nodos con IP publica amplian la superficie de ataque expuesta a Internet aunque esten detras de Cloud Armor y firewalls; incumple el requisito de cero exposicion publica de los nodos exigido por HIPAA.

options.B: Configure the cluster with its public endpoint disabled, reachable solely from authorized VPC subnets via firewall rules filtering corporate networks.
options.D: Configure IAP TCP forwarding so admins reach the API Server via a VPC bastion, granting iam.tunnelResourceAccessor instead of filtering corporate networks by CIDR.

distractors.B: Deshabilitar el endpoint publico solo permite el acceso desde dentro de la VPC; no distingue entre las jump-boxes corporativas autorizadas y cualquier otra carga de trabajo de la VPC, por lo que no implementa el filtrado CIDR granular exigido.
distractors.D: Un tunel IAP hacia un bastion da acceso a quien pueda llegar al bastion, pero no reemplaza el filtrado CIDR de Master Authorized Networks en el propio endpoint de la API de Kubernetes.

options.A: Configure 2-Step Verification with hardware security keys (FIDO2/Titan) for each developer and administrator, shorten the Google Cloud session length in the Admin console to four hours, and require reauthentication with the key before a sensitive administrative action or role grant.
options.B: Create a VPC Service Controls perimeter around each project and attach an Access Level admitting solely the corporate egress ranges 198.51.100.0/22, so that an API call or Cloud Console action arriving from an address outside those ranges is refused at the perimeter boundary.

distractors.A: Las llaves de seguridad y la reautenticacion periodica refuerzan la autenticacion, pero no evaluan el estado del dispositivo (cifrado de disco, parches del SO) ni bloquean laptops personales no gestionadas como exige el escenario.
distractors.B: Un perimetro de VPC Service Controls filtra por rango de IP de salida, no por identidad de usuario ni postura del dispositivo; una laptop personal conectada desde una IP corporativa autorizada seguiria pasando el control.
